slots.notes: Fullscreen fixed-inset looping background video for light theme (autoplay, muted, playsInline, object-fit cover, z-index -1); no overlay sits on top.
Fullscreen fixed-inset looping background video swapped in for dark theme (autoplay, muted, playsInline, object-fit cover, z-index -1); keyed to force reload on theme toggle.

Circular user/host avatars used everywhere: 48px profile button, 32px meeting host, card-footer member stacks + count badges across all 8 cards, 18px chart-marker faces on Card 3, the 44/40px active-speaker and participant cluster in the bottom bar, and the 2x2 mini-avatar grid in the components button. Placeholders are pravatar/seed-keyed; brand should supply a pool of square headshots cropped to circles.
Four 160x100 (radius 16) thumbnails in the horizontal drag-to-scroll Screen Share strip on Card 8; placeholders are picsum seed images.

lucide-react glyph set tinted by current text color: Plus, Zap, MoreHorizontal, BarChart2, Video, VideoOff, Mic, MicOff, Play, Search, X, plus the moon/sun mode-switch marks. Monochrome line icons inheriting --text-main / accent.
Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700) from Google Fonts; single family drives all display, body, and numeric/mono usage in the template.

mechanic: A fixed-height non-scrolling 4x2 liquid-glass card grid over a theme-swapped fullscreen looping video, with hover lift (translateY -3px scale 1.01), an animated voice-wave equalizer badge on active speakers, and a sliding mode-switch handle toggling dark-mode glass tokens.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind component spec; lucide-react icons, Inter via Google Fonts, optional @supabase/supabase-js wiring.
reskinNotes: Heavy use of inline rgba glass tokens and hardcoded hex (#3b82f6 blue, #e05e36 orange tag, #ff4545 alert red, #e5e7eb/#f0f0f0 greys) baked directly into card and chip styles rather than CSS variables, so a reskin must touch many inline values. The grain texture is a procedurally generated inline SVG feTurbulence filter (not a brand asset). Card titles, subtitles, count badges, and the Weekly Insights bar-chart height arrays (24 blue + 36 grey fixed integers) are hardcoded in markup. Light-mode UI assumes dark-leaning translucent text-over-video contrast; brand video luminance must keep all text contrast-safe in both themes. Layout (40px radii, 88x48 mode switch, 44/48px avatar circles) is metric-tuned to Inter.
